summary: The base reproduces both reported backend causes. The exact candidate repairs bidirectional mask construction and preserves the encoder sliding-window argument. Candidate regressions and independent CPU/GPU numerical boundary cases pass. Full ModernBERT HTTP embedding parity remains unverified because the selected checkout lacks that model implementation and prepared weights.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before comparison of the base mask and SDPA output against independently constructed bidirectional references; four non-causal boundary cases failed and attention maximum absolute error was 1.6200188398361206.
Six independent mask cases passed, including non-square offset, zero-width, oversized-window, and causal compatibility; CPU SDPA maximum absolute error was 1.1920928955078125e-07.
The candidate's four regressions passed: bidirectional mask, encoder forwarding, causal offset compatibility, and zero-width behavior.
A 257-token/window-128 candidate mask equaled the positional reference and GPU SDPA matched explicit masked softmax with maximum absolute error 3.5762786865234375e-07.
All applicable formatting, lint, safety, and registered-test validation hooks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned GPU was visible. rocm_agent_enumerator reported gfx950; Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 identified it as AMD Instinct MI350X. The candidate's GPU attention output matched the independent oracle within 3.5762786865234375e-07.

remaining_limitations: The selected checkout does not contain the ModernBERT implementation linked by the original report.
The jhu-clsp/ettin-encoder-17m weights were not prepared, so the original HTTP/HuggingFace long-context embedding parity test was not run.
The focused CPU and gfx950 checks establish backend mask and attention numerics, not ModernBERT semantic accuracy, HTTP serving behavior, or distributed execution.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json provides no native rebuild target; validation used the checked-out Python source, so no native rebuild was applicable.
